title: [ingest] Promotion requires 0.85 agreement by default
summary: The promotion gate defaults to a threshold of 0.85, with the value also overridable from `PROMOTION_THRESHOLD`. That is the project's shipped cutoff for deciding when a candidate crosses from discussion into promotion.
